{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Atraken Hope''''' was one of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] that evacuated [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from [[Atraken/Legends|Atraken]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Trilos]] following the [[Battle of Atraken]]. By [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], it was being used as a source of spare parts to keep the [[Atrakenite]]'s other light freighter, the ''[[Atraken Memory]]'', operational.
